name: nginx2root
tile_line: Only if HTTP/2 is on. Public exploit, no attacks yet.
summary: A bug in nginx's HTTP/2 handling lets an attacker with no login crash nginx or run code as the nginx worker user. Despite the name, it doesn't give root by itself (Xint got root by chaining it with a separate Linux kernel bug, covered on our Linux SCTP root page), and code execution needs ASLR to be off or bypassed. A second HTTP/2 bug (CVE-2026-123633) is fixed by the same releases, and so are three other nginx bugs (HTTP/3, resolver, mail proxy) that Xint groups under the same name; turning off HTTP/2 doesn't cover those.

affected.label: nginx 1.9.5 – 1.31.8
affected.text: Stable 1.30.7 and later are fixed. Also NGINX Plus 37.0.0–37.0.7.1 and 37.1.0–37.2.0.1; older NGINX Plus R33–R36 get no fix (sources differ on R33), so move to 37.x. Distros backport fixes without changing `nginx -v`, so check the package against your distro's advisory. After upgrading, restart: a reload keeps the old binary.

affected.label: HTTP/2 is on anywhere
affected.text: Either `http2 on;` or `listen ... http2`, on any server block. Static-only sites count. Behind a proxy that terminates HTTP/2, the public exploit likely fails, but the bug is still there.

do.label: Upgrade nginx
do.text: 1.31.9 (mainline) or 1.30.7 (stable). NGINX Plus: 37.3.0.1 or 37.0.8.1. Debian (DSA-6642-1, DLA-4918-1) and Ubuntu (USN-9159-1) have fixed packages. Then restart.

do.label: Can't upgrade? Turn off HTTP/2
do.text: Set `http2 off;` in each server block and remove `http2` from every `listen` line (before 1.25.1, only the `listen` change). This breaks native gRPC, and doesn't cover the HTTP/3, resolver and mail-proxy bugs the same upgrade fixes.

do.label: Check bundled nginx
do.text: Kong, APISIX, NGINX Gateway Fabric and community ingress-nginx bundle nginx with HTTP/2 on by default. APISIX 3.21.0 and NGINX Gateway Fabric 2.9.0 are built on the fixed 1.31.9; F5's NGINX Ingress Controller 5.8.0 still ships 1.31.8. Community ingress-nginx gets no fixes after March 2026. Check with your vendor.

slack: nginx2root (CVE-2026-123007, plus CVE-2026-123633): unauthenticated RCE (as the worker user, not root) in nginx 1.9.5–1.31.8 when HTTP/2 is enabled. Public exploit since 18 Nov, no attacks seen, not in KEV. Check: nginx -T | grep http2. Fix: 1.31.9 / 1.30.7 and restart, or set http2 off;.
